description: This file declares the MetalTensorImplStorage class, a part of the 'at::native::metal' namespace, which provides an interface for managing tensor storage with Metal API support, including size/stride management and data transfer methods.

classes.name: MetalTensorImplStorage
classes.description: A final class managing tensor storage in Metal API context, including size, stride, data access, and transfer functionalities.

methods.name: defined
methods.description: Checks whether the tensor storage is defined.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of the tensor as an IntArrayRef.

methods.name: strides
methods.description: Returns the strides of the tensor as an IntArrayRef.

methods.name: dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the tensor.

methods.name: set_data_from_host
methods.description: Copies data from a host pointer into the tensor storage.

methods.name: copy_data_to_host
methods.description: Copies tensor data to a host pointer.

methods.name: texture
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the MPSImageWrapper texture.
